posts.title: Quick writing & editing tips
posts.description: Some of these are excerpted from common writing mistakes to avoid: * Do no use brackets. If something feels important to be said in brackets, it probably belongs outside of it. * Avoid long sentences. * Write the first draft without adding any images. * Avoid exclamation marks. Your sentence should surprise by itself.

posts.title: Imagine: Free(dom) software version
posts.description: What does being free in the digital world look like? Here’s my fork of John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s song Imagine, extending their utopian sense of freedom to digital technology. Imagine there’s no Meta, it’s easy if you try No copyright chains below us, above us
